You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many pounds of ore can 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes mine in a 30-day month? One dwarf can mine 12 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands. One dwarf can mine twice as much ore with an iron pickaxe as with bare hands. One dwarf can mine 50% more ore with a steel pickaxe than with an iron pickaxe. There are 40 dwarves with steel pickaxes. The month has 30 days.
